source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "science and technology studies" AND digital AND infrastructure
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"science and technology studies" AND digital AND infrastructure,is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("science and technology studies" AND "digital" AND "infrastructure")
